edges.reason: The count-of-tens addition is a small-number addition, such as three tens plus four tens using three plus four.
Adding whole tens represents each operand as a count of tens, using decimal place-value meaning.
edges.scope: multiples of ten as counts of tens

edges.reason: The part-whole criterion expressly represents joining by addition; the written two-digit subtraction algorithm is the wrong prerequisite. The scope is operation meaning rather than a required count range. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
edges.scope: The joining meaning of addition in the explicit part-plus-part-equals-total relation

edges.reason: The part-whole criterion expressly represents the missing part through subtraction, without needing a column algorithm. The scope is operation meaning rather than every within-ten fact. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
edges.scope: The take-away meaning of subtraction in the explicit total-minus-part relation

edges.reason: The percent criterion explicitly represents the multiplicative relation between two numbers. A hundredths fraction represents that same quotient comparison; avoiding formal ratio terminology does not remove the relation itself. Require only this shared meaning, not prior completion of ratio exercises or notation.
edges.scope: The quotient meaning of the multiplicative comparison between two quantities

edges.reason: Bar charts build general skill in reading a statistical graph. Pie charts, however, encode part-to-whole shares by area, which is a different representation that does not depend on bar reading.

Reading explicitly labeled pie percentages and computing the corresponding counts can be done without formal sector vocabulary. Sector geometry explains the picture but is not required by those stated tasks.
edges.scope: relating slice size to share of the whole

edges.reason: Interpreting pie labels as parts per hundred of the total uses percent meaning directly.
edges.scope: interpreting percent labels and computing parts
